fields: h, items [{t, d, link, art, label}]. art: an illustration id from ART (Hero.js); default the link's page when it has one. label: short stop name on the run (default t).
best_for: ProjectRun tells ordered steps as one run the reader scrolls along: on wide screens a sticky stage shows the current step's equipment drawing, its number set huge and a pipe whose water fills stop by stop as the steps scroll past.

items.d: We turn your user requirement specification (URS) into a design you approve before anything is built.
We build the PP skids and record each joint.
A factory acceptance test (FAT) with water, to a protocol your quality unit approves.
Site acceptance tests on your utilities, then installation and operational qualification (IQ/OQ) to protocols your quality unit approves.
Performance qualification (PQ) support through 12 months of data, then service and spare parts.
